review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer (PostgreSQL DBA)
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Engineer (PostgreSQL DBA) based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical database infrastructure within a data-driven, international environment. You will focus heavily on PostgreSQL administration, performance optimization, security, reliability, and scalability across core data systems. Beyond hands-on DBA responsibilities, you will translate business needs into actionable data engineering priorities and help ensure technical solutions support broader organizational objectives. You will collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders while guiding the team on database, reporting, and data management best practices. The position also places a strong emphasis on modern AI and automation, using emerging tools to improve database operations, testing, reliability, and software delivery. It is an ideal opportunity for a senior data professional who combines deep technical expertise with leadership, communication, and a continuous-improvement mindset. Accountabilities Administer, maintain, and optimize PostgreSQL databases, with additional responsibility for SQL Server and Oracle environments, ensuring strong performance, availability, scalability, and security. Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, partitions, and related structures to support efficient queries, growing data volumes, and long-term scalability. Monitor database health and performance, identify bottlenecks, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement query and infrastructure optimizations. Manage database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes to support operational resilience and business continuity. Implement and maintain database security practices, including access controls, encryption, auditing, and other measures designed to protect sensitive data. Ensure database environments comply with applicable data governance requirements, internal security policies, and relevant industry standards. Participate in daily standups, prioritize technical work, and align engineering activities with evolving business needs and organizational priorities. Translate business requirements into well-defined data engineering and database administration tasks, helping the team focus effort where it delivers the greatest business value. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data solutions and Power BI-related initiatives are technically sound and aligned with business objectives. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members while promoting best practices across database management, reporting, data quality, and operational processes. Apply modern AI models and developer tools to improve PostgreSQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, testing, and operational runbook automation. Use AI-assisted approaches to generate test scenarios, expand regression coverage, identify edge cases, and improve the efficiency of engineering workflows. Build practical automation that reduces repetitive manual work while maintaining appropriate standards for quality, security, reliability, and auditability. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, select appropriate models and tools for specific tasks, and apply secure approaches when working with sensitive or business-critical data. Identify opportunities for measurable efficiency gains, including faster delivery cycles, improved system stability, reduced operational effort, and greater predictability across engineering activities. Requirements Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL database administration, particularly performance tuning, optimization, security, monitoring, backup, and recovery. Experience administering or supporting additional relational database technologies such as SQL Server and Oracle. Strong understanding of database architecture, schema design, indexing, partitioning, query optimization, availability, and scalability. Practical experience with database monitoring, troubleshooting, disaster recovery planning, and operational reliability. Solid knowledge of database security principles, including access management, encryption, auditing, governance, and protection of sensitive information. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to detail and a structured approach to diagnosing technical issues. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to prioritize workloads, manage competing requirements, and align technical execution with business objectives. Leadership and mentoring capabilities, with the confidence to guide team members and establish effective data management and engineering practices. Experience translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with Power BI and data reporting environments is beneficial, although direct Power BI development is not required. Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling, with the ability to apply AI to software delivery, database operations, and engineering productivity. Experience using AI for PostgreSQL performance tuning, reliability validation, migration planning, operational automation, and testing workflows. Ability to create automation that delivers measurable improvements while preserving quality, security, and auditability. Sound judgment when evaluating AI-generated outputs, including the ability to select suitable tools and apply secure patterns when handling sensitive data. review_candidates.title: Full Stack Developer
review_candidates.description: Before anything else, the practical stuff - we'd rather you know now than find out at the interview: Salary: 400 JOD/month to start Office role in Amman, not remote. Hours are 1 PM to 10 PM Not a heads-down coding job. Part of your day is technical support, for our own team and for the venues on our platform. If you'd rather never talk to a non-technical person, this isn't the one Releases and problems don't always land inside office hours. When something is going live or something breaks, you're expected to be reachable You'll be the junior in a small tech team. Real work from week one, and someone senior reviewing all of it If any of that doesn't fit your life right now, that's completely okay - we appreciate you reading this far. If it sounds like what you're looking for, keep going. Vyltic is Jordan's largest padel network - 8,500+ players, 70+ courts in 4 cities, 200+ events so far. We build two products: the player app people use to find matches, get ranked and play tournaments, and the SaaS platform our partner venues run their bookings, scheduling and operations on. Both are live, both have a long list of things to build next. That's where you come in. The job has two halves. Building: you take a feature from a design or a described behaviour to something working, on a TypeScript dashboard and a NestJS backend on PostgreSQL. You write the endpoint and the query behind it. You fix bugs by tracing them from what the user saw back to the cause, not by patching the symptom. Within your first few months you get into our Flutter app. Nothing goes live without staging, testing and review, and that includes your work from day one. Support: when customer service has a player who can't see their booking, when operations needs a tournament fixed in the system, when a venue manager calls because their dashboard isn't behaving, that comes to you. You work out whether it's a bug, a data issue or a misunderstanding, fix what needs fixing, and explain it back in plain language to someone who doesn't know what an API is. Half the value of this role is that the people around you stop being stuck. What we're after in a junior is less about what you know and more about how you work. Do you read the code before you add to it? Do you follow what's already there instead of inventing your own way? Do you test your work before handing it over, and write down what you built so the next person can pick it up? Do you ask early when you're stuck, not after three days? And when someone non-technical comes to you frustrated, do you stay patient and get them sorted? If you'd rather say "I don't understand this yet" than guess, you're our kind of person. Technically: working JavaScript and TypeScript, a modern front-end framework (React preferred - work, study or personal projects all count), an understanding of REST APIs and some experience writing one in Node.js, basic SQL, and comfortable with Git. Arabic and English, both, since you'll be supporting people in either. Flutter, NestJS, PostgreSQL, an ORM like TypeORM or Prisma, or Arabic/English interfaces are pluses, not musts. If you've built something real and it works, that counts for more than a degree. One thing we want to be clear about: we're not hiring for a gig, and we're not looking for someone passing through. We're looking for someone who wants to build a career - and this is a company where that's actually possible. We'd rather have ten exceptional people than fifty average ones, so the bar is high and stays high. But performance here is measured openly, and growth follows it. We're expanding into new sports and new markets across the Middle East, and the products you'll be working on are the ones that carry that expansion. The people who prove themselves early end up carrying the bigger roles when we get there. The salary above is where this starts - it is not where it goes. There's no ceiling here. It's just earned. To apply: send your CV to careers@vyltic.com with subject line "Full Stack Developer", a few lines on why you fit what we described above, and a link to something you've built - GitHub, a deployed project, anything real.
